def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = min(separators, key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    overlaps = any(a != 0 and b != 0
                   for ra, rb in zip(left, right)
                   for a, b in zip(ra, rb))
    if overlaps:
        return left
    return [[b if b != 0 else a for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
